scope: One actual agentd service source, two unique exact replacements. Proposed next-attempt diagnostic, not a failure repair and not a qualification result.

composite_check.consequence: Use actual cbf preimage 8f5e; this diagnostic does not overwrite any of the 195 future overlay entries.

actual_failure.observed_parent_result: HostAuthorityService serving result ultimately reports PeerDenied; registration thread awaits RETIRE_READY and gets EAGAIN.
actual_failure.no_reuse_of_prior_cause: V45's retained-time age_ns=509605142 is not evidence for this V46 failure. The old 64-record timing diagnostics were exhausted before the RetiredSession failure.

source_reasoning.fact: The client has already executed the original owner-before check, request-prefix write and request-body write before the reported read-prefix refusal.
source_reasoning.limit: The report does not establish a complete or zero-byte response prefix; read_until can observe EOF before all four bytes have arrived.

source_reasoning.fact: OwnerChannel::read_until maps an actual read result of zero to Closed. Idle server reads use the original session end; the 500 ms request deadline begins after the first request byte.

The original peer exchange shuts down that stream on any original exchange error. Handler failure, post-handler owner/deadline failure, framing/read/write failure, and peer failure remain distinct possibilities without a server-side error record.
The parent joins the original lane threads in listener order: Observation, Issuer, Checkpoint, DeviceConsumerFrontier, NotesConsumerFrontier, and returns on the first joined Err.
source_reasoning.limit: Join order is not chronological failure order.

source_reasoning.fact: At run time OwnerChannel::check/wait returns PeerDenied on an event from the retained original pidfd. PeerDenied also exists in constructor identity validation.
source_reasoning.limit: The final parent value alone does not identify which PeerDenied branch ran or prove it was the initial failure.

source_reasoning.inference: A Device frontier failure could close its stream, make the child return and exit, then cause the earlier-joined Observation lane to report PeerDenied on the child's pidfd. This is a source-supported masking mechanism, not a claim that the log proves this exact timeline.

source_reasoning.fact: The frontier writer callback preserves its original writer witness, proof, issuer-head, backend and lease checks but maps internal io errors to Unavailable. The new diagnostic does not pretend that an opaque handler Unavailable resolves that deeper leaf.

diagnostic_points.when: Only when the exact original constructor returned Err; log then propagate that original Err through the same ?.

Only after the exact original handler returned Err, after its owner-local scopes have ended. The original HostAuthorityPeerChannel still receives the same Err and performs its original stream shutdown.
Only after the original exchange returned Err and performed its original error-path shutdown; log then propagate the same Err through the same ?.

logging_contract.compiled_logging: All three calls and the logging helper are gated by cfg(test), which is active in the actual agentd Root test binary. No logging is added to the contracts dependency.
logging_contract.stderr_failure: std::io::Write / writeln! returns are ignored; no unwrap/expect or changed returned error.
logging_contract.output_bound: The existing serve function stops on the original Err. One failing constructor emits one record; an exchange emits one record, plus one handler record only when the original handler itself failed. No new counter or retry loop.
logging_contract.limits: This is test-only error-path I/O and can affect error-path wall time. It does not diagnose the internal substage of an opaque handler Unavailable or every contract framing substage. It does not instrument the pre-existing Checkpoint validate_peer call that precedes channel construction.

preservation.byte_proof: Both exact replacements have unique forward and reverse anchors; reversing both reconstructs all original source bytes.

metadata.exact_delta_required: None. The original required/forbidden fields and the existing human-text caller/definition relation retain their exact strings. No checker, typed helper, allowlist, caller inventory, or receiver is modified.
metadata.limits: Local raw/masked projection only; the original checker was not run. The final source/metadata combination remains subject to the unchanged native entry.

independent_review.status: Static independent source review: no confirmed local blocker; no execution or diagnosis of initiating leaf.
